# gdrive_permissions (Data Source)

List all permission pages for an item, including inherited grants. This data source does not modify the ACL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gdrive_permissions" "engineering" {
  file_id = "SHARED_DRIVE_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String) File, folder, or Shared Drive ID.

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `direct_role` (String) Permission direct_role. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
- `domain` (String) Permission domain. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
- `email_address` (String) Permission email_address. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
- `has_direct_grant` (Boolean) Whether this item has a direct grant for this principal.
- `id` (String) Permission id. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
- `role` (String) Permission role. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
- `type` (String) Permission type. direct_role is null for inherited-only grants.
